Chapter 1118 – Fighting Against Sacred King Samsara

“So Sacred King Samsara’s true intention was to kill this woman!” The Emperor of Death quickly flew toward the stream.

Whoosh!

The Emperor of Death’s expression changed dramatically after scanning the place with his Divine Sense.

“Master, Liu Qinyin’s not here!” the Emperor of Death immediately messaged Sacred King Samsara.

“What? Follow my directions and kill her!” Sacred King Samsara’s impatient tone sounded in the Emperor of Death’s soul.

Sacred King Samsara had obviously left a Mark of Samsara on Liu Qinyin’s body, so it was extremely easy for him to find her location.

The Emperor of Death then headed in a certain direction as he followed Sacred King Samsara’s guidance.

Liu Qinyin was flying quickly across the sky in the distance.

“There seems to be a glint of hope in that direction. Did Master return?” Liu Qinyin’s eyes were lost, and she turned her head around a while later.

“Hehe, Liu Qinyin, where do you think you’re running to?” The Emperor of Death descended as he released a terrifying Intent.

Liu Qinyin was completely suppressed by the Emperor of Death and unable to move. It was as if she could turn into ashes at any moment.

“Emperor of Death, why do you want to kill me?” Liu Qinyin said in fear and shock.

“Hahaha, if you really want to help your master, you should just commit suicide!” The Emperor of Death laughed.

“Impossible…!” Liu Qinyin didn’t believe that the Emperor of Death was being ordered to kill her by her master. Why would her master, who had raised her for more than a dozen years, send someone to kill her?

An accident must have befallen Master, and the Emperor of Death escaped Master’s control….

Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!

Right at this moment, several black figures flew out from behind Liu Qinyin.

“I finally managed to catch up!” a cold and wicked male exclaimed.

When Liu Qinyin saw this male, her mind suddenly shook. Wasn’t this the male from her dreams? Although the appearance was slightly different, Liu Qinyin felt like this person was the person that she had been seeing in her dreams.

“Zhao Feng…? Wait, no!” The Emperor of Death’s expression changed. Although this person looked exactly like Zhao Feng, the latter’s aura and cultivation were completely different.

“Kill him!” Zhao Wang’s eyes were cold as he stared at the Emperor of Death before looking deeply at Liu Qinyin.

“Yes, Grand Elder!” Several Elders from the Dark Ghost Clan took out a Ghost Dao array and started to use it.

“Hmph, you’re courting death!” The Emperor of Death released a terrifying aura.

He had the Eye of Death and a Samsara Immortal Body, so why would he be scared of a few Emperors? Furthermore, after the battle in the God corpse, the abilities of his Eye of Death were stronger than ever.

“We’ll see who the one courting death is!” Zhao Wang snickered coldly as he charged forward.

“Black Hole of Death!” Zhao Wang circulated his right eye as he locked onto the area around the Emperor of Death.

Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!

A strong surge of Death power formed a black ball that radiated a terrifying suction force as it flew toward the Emperor of Death.

The Black Hole of Death was a brand-new secret technique that Zhao Wang had created according to the supreme techniques of the Dark Ghost Clan and the Gaze of Death. Of course, Zhao Feng had also helped.

Shua! Shua! Shua!

On the other side, the Elders of the Dark Ghost Clan controlled the Ghost Dao array and trapped the Emperor of Death inside it.

“The Eye of Death!” The expression of the Emperor of Death turned crazy. Wasn’t this the Eye of Death that Zhao Feng had stolen?

“Give me back my Eye of Death!”

…

Elsewhere, the battle between Zhao Feng and Sacred King Samsara had already started. Next to Sacred King Samsara was a Sacred King-level Samsara Immortal Body.

“Sacred King Samsara, didn’t you want to tell me the whereabouts of Liu Qinyin?” Zhao Feng couldn’t help but smile.

In reality, Bi Qingyue had quickly found the various places where Sacred King Samsara stayed before he entered the God corpse soon after Zhao Feng gave her the task. Coincidentally, the place in question was very close to the Dark Ghost Clan, so Zhao Feng sent Zhao Wang to check.

Zhao Feng could roughly guess where Liu Qinyin was by sensing the location of Sacred King Samsara through the Mark of Samsara. However, because Zhao Feng also had a Mark of Samsara on him, he didn’t immediately go find Liu Qinyin in case Sacred King Samsara sensed it. Therefore, Zhao Feng headed toward Sacred King Samsara while Zhao Wang went to save Liu Qinyin.

This was the first time Zhao Wang had come into play, and he was very useful. Zhao Wang was already very strong, and when the two lord dynasties were scouting out the God corpse, Zhao Wang persuaded those that supported him in the Dark Ghost Clan to make him the Grand Elder. After becoming the Grand Elder, Zhao Wang didn’t hide anything anymore and used the resources that Zhao Feng gave him to cultivate crazily. He now had the strength of an unrivalled Emperor.

Zhao Wang’s soul was split from Zhao Feng’s, so he had a lot of potential. His soul had reached the level of a Sacred Lord long ago.

“The Eye of Death! It’s you?” Sacred King Samsara immediately understood after hearing what the Emperor of Death said. There was only one other person that had the Eye of Death.

“Zhao Feng, how dare you try to steal my disciple!?” Sacred King Samsara roared in anger.

Weng!

Black lines started to spin in Sacred King Samsara’s left eye.

Hu! Hu! Hu!

Black-robed figures started to appear one after another and surround Zhao Feng.

Zhao Feng’s expression changed slightly as he looked over them. Two Sacred Kings, four late-stage Sacred Lords, and more than ten early-stage Sacred Lords. Although he knew that Sacred King Samsara had many Samsara Immortal Bodies, the number and strength of them still shocked him.

Shua!

Zhao Feng waved his left hand and summoned some helpers as well.

Miao miao!

The little thieving cat and the Cloud Silkworm Saint Butterfly appeared. Next to them was Sacred Lord Myriad Forms and some Sky Shaking Golden Apes, who had become Sacred Lords ages ago.

“Go!” Zhao Feng exclaimed.

Weng~ Weng~ Weng~

Zhao Feng used the Lightning Wings Flying Technique and charged directly into the enemy forces toward Sacred King Samsara.

“Kill him!” Sacred King Samsara roared.

As long as Sacred King Samsara had time, he could create more and more Samsara Immortal Bodies. He had left many Marks of Samsara on the Sacred Lords and Sacred Kings in the God corpse. Many experts had also died in the fight against True God Tian Fa.

However, Sacred King Samsara had also used up a lot of his Samsara Origin Power while fighting and needed time to recover before he could turn those experts into Samsara Immortal Bodies. If Zhao Feng had come a while later, Sacred King Samsara was confident he could’ve killed Zhao Feng immediately.

Boom!

More than twenty Samsara Immortal Bodies started to attack Zhao Feng.

Whoosh!

Zhao Feng flew across the sky and tried to avoid the attacks of the two Sacred Kings.

Peng! Peng! Bam!

The attacks from the other Samsara Immortal Bodies landed on Zhao Feng, but they didn’t even leave a mark on him.

My Sacred Lightning Body has reached the late stage of the 6th level. Attacks from anyone below the Sacred King level aren’t able to injure me!

Zhao Feng was very confident in his Sacred Lightning Body.

At the same time, the Sky Shaking Golden Apes and Cloud Silkworm Saint Butterfly quickly entered the battle and instantly suppressed the early-stage Sacred Lord Samsara Immortal Bodies. The little thieving cat and Sacred Lord Myriad Forms easily took care of the late-stage Sacred Lords.

“How is this possible…? Your strength…!” Sacred King Samsara’s expression changed dramatically and lost all color. He didn’t expect Zhao Feng’s strength to improve so fast or for his body-strengthening technique to be so profound. The attacks from so many Samsara Immortal Bodies were actually unable to do any damage to him.

“The two of you, stop him!” Sacred King Samsara gave the order to the two Sacred King Samsara Immortal Bodies.

At the same time, Sacred King Samsara started to circulate his Intent to restrict Zhao Feng. The battle-power of the Eyes of Samsara themselves was very weak, but Sacred King Samsara was still a Sacred King.

“Hmph!” Zhao Feng harrumphed coldly as he released a surge of terrifying Intent into the sky and knocked aside the Intent of the three Sacred Kings.

“His Soul Intent has also reached the level of a Sacred King!” Sacred King Samsara was stunned once more. The reason why Zhao Feng broke through to the late stages of the Mystic Light Realm so quickly was very likely due to the amount of resources he obtained in the God corpse, but Sacred King Samsara didn’t expect Zhao Feng’s Soul Intent to be so strong as well. The God corpse had many resources that helped one’s cultivation and state of existence, but resources that helped the soul were extremely rare.

“Sky Destroying Sacred Lightning Palm!” Zhao Feng circulated his Fire of Wind Lightning Sacred Power and thrust out toward the two Sacred King Samsara Immortal Bodies.

“This brat’s power is terrifying!”

“The Great Gan Lord Dynasty has such a fearsome prodigy?”

The two Sacred King Samsara Immortal Bodies were stunned.

Boom!

The two Sacred Kings had to use many techniques and team up to block Zhao Feng’s attack.

“The power of God Tribulation Lightning?” The expression of one Samsara Immortal Body turned to surprise. The parts of their bodies that were damaged by the power of God Tribulation Lightning were very hard to recover from even if they had Samsara Immortal Bodies.

“Tribulation Lightning Eye Flame!” Zhao Feng’s left eye locked onto Sacred King Samsara as a strong surge of Eye Intent appeared.

Voom!

A ball of transparent purple-and-gold lightning-fire exploded in Sacred King Samsara’s face. This technique contained a large amount of God Tribulation Lightning, so it was able to critically threaten even Sacred King Samsara’s Samsara Immortal Body.

“Arghhh…!” Sacred King Samsara immediately cried out.

At this moment, a necklace around Sacred King Samsara’s neck started to blink, and it quickly helped Sacred King Samsara block the power of the Tribulation Lightning Eye Flame.

“A peak-tier Heaven-grade soul-defending secret treasure!” Zhao Feng’s expression turned to shock. Soul-defending treasures were more precious than other treasures, and Sacred King Samsara’s treasure would be very rare even in the continent zone as a whole.

Whoosh!

Sacred King Samsara quickly retreated several miles and pulled away from Zhao Feng. Although he had a soul-defending treasure, Zhao Feng’s soul attacks contained the power of God Tribulation Lightning, which heavily damaged his treasure.

“Use the substandard God weapon and kill him!” Sacred King Samsara said.

Sacred King Samsara had also gained a lot in the God corpse.

Whoosh!

A substandard God weapon appeared in each of the two Sacred King Samsara Immortal Bodies’ hands. One was a golden-white pearl of light that gave off a strong glow. Profound golden talismans floated within the pearl and radiated a faint wisp of Divine Power. The other substandard God weapon was a blue jade ruler. A watery vapor floated around the ruler and summoned the element of Water from Heaven and Earth.

“Zhao Feng, since you saved Liu Qinyin, you can go die!” Sacred King Samsara had a deadly expression.
